verdict: MATERIAL DEFECT CONFIRMED — the wrapper cannot express 'outer route-pass 0' while still performing the admitted operation

authority.finding: SRC27 is the ONLY source carrying a `governed_full_route_passes` account (EXACT 1, expression 'exactly 1; authority also supplies max 1'). SRC02/SRC06/SRC08/SRC12/SRC14/SRC26 carry NO such account — i.e. exact 0.

the_two_failure_modes_measured.result: REFUSED BEFORE ANY OPERATION with ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED; zero lower-layer accounts moved; no session created
the_two_failure_modes_measured.why: RoutePassSpec.admits() returns False whenever completed_so_far >= maximum, and maximum=0 makes that true on the FIRST attempt. The gate therefore blocks the source's admitted SELECTED/METADATA operation entirely.
the_two_failure_modes_measured.consequence: for the six non-route sources, an outer exact-zero constraint makes the source UNEXECUTABLE

the_two_failure_modes_measured.result: the operation RAN, then failed AFTER the fact with POST_EXECUTION_CONSTRAINT_FAILED
the_two_failure_modes_measured.consequence: the source operation was already performed against the real source before the outer constraint was evaluated

root_cause.statement: execute() increments _passes_completed on EVERY successful session.run(), regardless of the plan's row-data mode. There is no notion of 'this plan is a full route pass' versus 'this plan is a non-route admitted operation'.
root_cause.code: pre553_execution_binding.py: `self._passes_completed += 1` immediately after `outcome = session.run(self.spec.plan)` with no mode test
root_cause.conceptual_error: the wrapper conflates 'an operation succeeded' with 'a full governed Route-B pass completed'

required_rule.semantics: full_route_passes counts COMPLETED GOVERNED FULL ROUTE PASSES. It is a workload account, not an access account.
must_hold: maximum=0 means 'this source plan admits no FULL ROUTE PASS', NOT 'no operation whatsoever'
a SELECTED or METADATA_ONLY (or other non-route) admitted operation must execute normally and leave full_route_passes observed at 0
only a plan that actually constitutes a governed full route pass may increment the outer account
the pre-operation outer gate must not use a route-pass ceiling to refuse a non-route operation

existing_court_locks_in_the_defect.asserts: RoutePassSpec(maximum=0) with a FULL plan -> ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED and ex._session is None
existing_court_locks_in_the_defect.problem: the test encodes the attack-A behaviour as intended. It only covers a FULL plan, so it never exercises the six non-route sources whose admitted operation must still run under an outer exact-zero.
existing_court_locks_in_the_defect.note: the test is not wrong about a FULL plan; it is silent on — and its helper encourages — the non-route case that breaks
